title: Slime Lanes Runner
heading: Slime Lanes
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Drag a tower from the shop (bottom left) onto a square; pick a tool, then click a tower.

1.name: Slimes
1.note: Clones crawl along one of four lanes.

2.name: Towers
2.note: Click the shop and drag: follow the mouse, then snap to a square.

3.name: Shooting
3.note: Bolts are clones of their tower, flying left.

4.name: Hits and coins
4.note: Touching the bolt colour costs health; coins and lives.

5.name: Chewing and repair
5.note: Slimes stop at a tower and chew it; Repair mends it.

6.name: Upgrades
6.note: Speed, Damage, Pierce, Strength: each tower keeps its own.

7.name: Waves
7.note: Tougher, faster slimes and a boss every fifth wave. The whole game.
